newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates ease to end at 22.625 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates ease to end at 22.625 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates closed lower at 22.625 percent from Monday's close of 22.75 percent, after trading in a range between 22.50 to 22.75 percent, dealers said.
"This is a stable market level," said Geza Egyed of West LB Hungaria, who does not expect sudden changes over the next days.
"Unless one of the major players miscalculates his position, overnight rates would probably stay around this level," he added.
